changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0076. Enable GYM_CHAT on business plans, including Business Free, so chat stays a plan feature flag. Index review: updates existing PlanFeatures rows by PlanId and FeatureCode. Performance note: one catalog update per business plan.

rollback.sql: UPDATE pf SET pf.[Enabled] = 0, pf.UpdatedAt = SYSUTCDATETIME() FROM app.PlanFeatures pf INNER JOIN app.Plans p ON p.Id = pf.PlanId WHERE pf.FeatureCode = N'GYM_CHAT' AND p.Code = N'BUSINESS_FREE';
